summary: Platform shows strong architectural patterns but legacy VB6 code presents critical security and reliability risks requiring immediate remediation.

hotspots.reason: Direct string concatenation in SQL queries creates SQL injection vulnerability
No input validation on user-provided account numbers and amounts
No error handling for database connection failures or invalid operations

provenance.evidence: rs.Open without try-catch or error checking

risks.title: Critical SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: Legacy VB6 code uses direct string concatenation for SQL queries, allowing potential attackers to manipulate database operations through user input fields

risks.title: Data Integrity Risk
risks.description: Lack of input validation and transaction management could lead to invalid account balances or failed operations without proper rollback

risks.title: Schema Migration Complexity
risks.description: Unknown target database schema and migration path from legacy VB6 data structures to modern C# entities

risks.title: Authentication Gap
risks.description: No visible authentication or authorization mechanisms in legacy code for banking operations
